records.text: Hemostasis: Stop all bleeding effects on yourself or an ally, converting each remaining turn of Bleed into a small amount of healing.
Transfusion: Transfer health from yourself to an ally, healing them for 150% of the health sacrificed.

Final Form – Aegis Incarnate: Transform into a living shield for 3 rounds, becoming immovable and redirecting 50% of all damage dealt to allies within 15 feet to yourself.
Guardian Pulse: 1/rest, redirect an attack from an adjacent ally to yourself and immediately counterstrike
Tool Proficiencies: Healer's kit, Herbalism kit
Equipment: A healer's kit, a bloodstained bandana or token from your service, a journal containing medical notes and sketches, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 10 gp.

Feature: Trauma Response: Your battlefield experience has honed your emergency medical skills. When you use a healer's kit to stabilize a dying creature, they regain 1 hit point immediately. Additionally, you can identify the nature and severity of injuries at a glance. Your service grants you Liked starting Reputation with veterans of the conflict you served in but Neutral starting Reputation with those who fought on the opposing side.

Burglar's Pack (16 gp). Includes a backpack, a bag of 1,000 ball bearings, 10 feet of string, a bell, 5 candles, a crowbar, a hammer, 10 pitons, a hooded lantern, 2 flasks of oil, 5 days rations, a tinderbox, and a waterskin. The pack also has 50 feet of hempen rope strapped to the side of it.

Dungeoneer's Pack (12 gp). Includes a backpack, a crowbar, a hammer, 10 pitons, 10 torches, a tinderbox, 10 days of rations, and a waterskin. The pack also has 50 feet of hempen rope strapped to the side of it.
Entertainer's Pack (40 gp). Includes a backpack, a bedroll, 2 costumes, 5 candles, 5 days of rations, a waterskin, and a disguise kit.
Explorer's Pack (10 gp). Includes a backpack, a bedroll, a mess kit, a tinderbox, 10 torches, 10 days of rations, and a waterskin. The pack also has 50 feet of hempen rope strapped to the side of it.
Priest's Pack (19 gp). Includes a backpack, a blanket, 10 candles, a tinderbox, an alms box, 2 blocks of incense, a censer, vestments, 2 days of rations, and a waterskin.

Unlock: Steal the soul of a living named enemy and bind it to a black crystal during a ritual event.
Soul Mark – Tag a creature for 1 minute; you know its direction if within 1 mile.
Soul Cage – Trap dying creature's soul; use it for various effects.
Soul Cage – Trap the soul of a dying humanoid.
Soul Bind – Trap a dying creature's soul, preventing resurrection.
An action and DC 10 Medicine check stabilizes a dying creature. A healer’s kit succeeds automatically but consumes one use.

Unless expressly stated, perceive the target, remain within range and have line of effect; total cover blocks targeting. “Ally” includes self unless it says OTHER. A list cannot contain a creature twice. Select up to the printed limit; an empty target list is not a valid way to farm activation benefits. Zones remain at their chosen point unless described as an aura; allies can leave and lose their benefits. An aura requires its owner conscious unless the card supplies a bounded exception. An effect ending at “end next turn” means the affected creature's next turn only when the card says target's; otherwise the user's.

**ASI/feat default:** where the reconciled class has no contrary explicit schedule, propose one ASI or eligible feat at class levels 4/8/12/16/19. Never award the same milestone again through feature selection or total character level.
**Retraining:** propose no general respec unless an explicit rule permits it. A future retraining system would be a separate design decision.

**Stabilize:** an Action and DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check, or an Action using one healer's-kit use automatically, stabilizes a living dying creature at zero. It remains Unconscious and makes no death saves. Roll 1d4 once when it becomes Stable and record its absolute recovery time that many hours later. If still Stable then, it regains 1 HP. Damage reaching normal HP cancels that deadline and resumes dying with the appropriate failures. Rest and Stable recovery use the same elapsed clock, so four hours of recovery inside an eight-hour Watch do not cost twelve hours. A later rest does not separately replay the Stable healing event.

This is an explicit Gameplay-derived integration. A living patient with at least one Wound receives eight elapsed hours of treatment with a medical kit and **one Supply**. **New provisional cost decision:** commit and consume that Supply once when treatment begins, on every attempt, even on success or interruption; no extra Supply is charged for failure. The retained Gameplay text requires one Supply and explicitly mentions consumption on failure but does not clearly settle success refunds. This candidate deliberately settles the ambiguity as a cost on every attempt, rather than claiming that interpretation is recovered source wording. Choose the Wound being treated before beginning. At completion roll Wisdom (Medicine) against the applicable tier DC: I 12, II 13, III 15, IV 16, V 18, VI 19. Unverified higher-tier procedures remain with the later Director/hazard pass.

Treating a Wound requires a medical kit, one Supply, eight hours, and Medicine against the tier DC. Critical Success removes two Wounds; Success removes one; Failure consumes the Supply; Critical Failure also inflicts 1 Strain.

Soul Bind removal targets pending creature or existing post-death remains as local anchor. With no remains, removal must expressly free the bound identity/soul; invent no physical anchor. No mind control, ownership or indefinite prison. True Resurrection still obeys actual identity/soul barriers, and an already-living identity is ineligible. Complete objects retain countering, Dissonance/Refrain, costs and source access.
